10:17 AM on my paper account: my setup showed a long, so I took one ES contract long at 7,268.25. Hard stop 4 points from entry, at 7,264.25. Sell limit waiting at 7,282.

facebook:
This morning I posted my bias for the day. It leaned short: London had broken the Asia high, and I expected price to rotate back into the Asia range.

It never came back. ES pushed through the London high, my line for changing my mind, and kept climbing past 7,200.

At 10:17 AM my setup appeared on the long side. In my paper trading account I went long one ES contract from 7,268.25 with a hard stop 4 points under entry at 7,264.25 and a sell limit at 7,282. The limit filled at 10:20: 13.75 points on one contract, $687.50 on paper.

A bias is a map, not a trade.

Do you stick with your morning bias, or let price change your mind?
